action7.name: Shield Up
action7.description: Pull Up Your Shield and Defend yourself and surrounding Tiles

effects.text: This is the Tutorial. Keep waking and all the Mechaniks will be explained to you.
You are currently in exploration Mode. When no Enemies are pressent you can move freely without spending Action Points (AP)
Combat is Turn-based. And you Spend AP to perform Actions like Moving or Attacking.
Be carefull. Stepping in the Line of Sight of an enemy Will trigger Combat.

Continue to the next Tile to see an Attack Roll. The Roll determins if Your attack Hits, and if Successful triggers a Damage Roll which you can inspect in the Battle Log in the top Right.The Roll is allways associated with one of your Skills and challenged against the Same Stat of the Enemy.
Besides the Attack Roll there is also a Save Roll.Failing or Suceeding a Save Roll can have different Effects. Step on the Next tile to Perform a Save roll against the Trap.
